lock.FINISHED: Tournament finished: the order no longer has any effect.
lock.SCORES_ENTERED: A score has been entered: the order is now locked.
lock.STARTED: The tournament has started: the seeding order is now locked.

registrations.seedingHint: This rank sets the first-round pairings; adjust it with the arrows, until kickoff.

seedingHintWaiting.TEAM: This rank will set the first-round pairings; adjustable here once two teams are entered.
seedingHintWaiting.SOLO: This rank will set the first-round pairings; adjustable here once two players are entered.

registrations.followsRanking: Sorted by the site ranking: each registration takes its place by rating, and the order follows ratings until the launch. Reorder the list to lock it: your order then takes precedence.
registrations.followsFrozenDraw: Ranks locked at kickoff from the site ranking: the draw's ranks, even if ratings have changed since.
registrations.removed: {name} is no longer among the entrants.

manualConfirm.title: Set the seeding order by hand?
manualConfirm.body: The seeding order currently follows the site ranking. Changing it permanently replaces it with an order set by the staff: the ranking will no longer reorder the list, and new registrations will be added at the end of the list.
manualConfirm.draw: No match exists yet: the first-round pairings will be drawn from this order at kickoff.

removeEntrant.title: Remove {name} from the tournament
removeEntrant.erased: The registration is erased: nothing will show that this entrant took part in the tournament, unlike a withdrawal. The slot goes back to the board.
removeEntrant.registrationOpen: Registration is open: the freed slot can be taken again, and this entrant can register again.
removeEntrant.registrationClosed: Registration is closed: no one can take this slot anymore, and this entrant can't register again unless registration is reopened.

TEAM.forfeitSelfConfirm: Your team will leave the tournament for good.

SOLO.forfeitSelfConfirm: You'll leave the tournament for good.

streamNotice.TEAM: This tournament's matches may be streamed live and recorded, showing your username, your team's name and your in-game results — never a webcam or voice chat. You can object and appear under a neutral name. When a streamed match starts, your team's name is also announced on the association's Discord.
streamNotice.SOLO: This tournament's matches may be streamed live and recorded, showing your username and your in-game results — never a webcam or voice chat. You can object and appear under a neutral name. When a streamed match starts, your username is also announced on the association's Discord: that announcement is part of the tournament you register for, the neutral name does not apply to it, and it is deleted on request.

register.notManager: Only your team's owner and managers can register it for a tournament.

TEAM.title: Register your team for “{name}”?
TEAM.final: The whole team will be entered. It won't be able to unregister itself: only the tournament staff can remove an entrant.

SOLO.title: Register for “{name}”?
SOLO.final: You won't be able to cancel this registration yourself: only the tournament staff can remove an entrant.

register.streamNoticeShort: Matches may be streamed live and recorded. You can object and appear under a neutral name.

danger.title: Destructive actions
danger.rollbackHint: Erases {stage} and reopens the previous round; repeatable back to the start of the tournament. Note the scores first: nothing is archived.
danger.rollbackHintFinished: Erases {stage}, reopens the previous round and the finished tournament, whose final standings are erased. Note the scores first: nothing is archived.
danger.deleteHint: Removes the tournament from the site for good, with its matches, registrations and standings. Teams and players are kept.

success.closedUnderfilled: Tournament closed: there weren't enough entrants to play a match.
success.started: Tournament started with {count, plural, one {# entrant} other {# entrants}}.
success.registrationClosed: Registration closed with {count, plural, one {# entrant} other {# entrants}}.

other.title: Declare a forfeit for {name}?

body.TEAM: The team will leave the tournament for good: the forfeit applies to everything left to play.
body.SOLO: The player will leave the tournament for good: the forfeit applies to everything left to play.

other.singleRound: For a forfeit on a single round, go through the match score.

button.label: Withdraw
button.selfTitle: Withdraw: your team leaves the tournament for good

selfTitle.TEAM: Withdraw: the team will leave the tournament for good
selfTitle.SOLO: Withdraw: the player will leave the tournament for good

endurance.otherTitle: Forfeit: declare {name} out for the rest of the tournament

forfeitCancel.success: {name}'s withdrawal cancelled: its standing is recalculated.
forfeitCancel.title: Cancel {name}'s withdrawal?

body.TEAM: The withdrawal is erased and the team's standing recalculated: it will be paired from the next round, unless the matches it has played eliminate it. The match lost by forfeit stays lost: correct its score if needed.
body.SOLO: The withdrawal is erased and the player's standing recalculated: they will be paired from the next round, unless the matches they have played eliminate them. The match lost by forfeit stays lost: correct its score if needed.

penaltyLift.success: Penalty lifted: {name} gets back {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
penaltyLift.title: Lift {name}'s penalty?
penaltyLift.body: {points, plural, one {# point goes} other {# points go}} back to the endurance pool, and everything the penalty triggered will be restored.
penaltyLift.frozenTitle: A round has been played since: giving these points back would put a team that didn't play it back in contention.
penaltyLift.buttonTitle: Lift this penalty: {name} gets back {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}

launch.fallback: The action couldn't go through. Try again in a moment.

cardActions.notCasting: You're no longer casting this match.

forceConfirm.title: Force the launch of {match}?
forceConfirm.body: The match starts without waiting for the missing “Ready” calls: the entrants can report their score right away.
forceConfirm.bodyDirect: The match starts without waiting for its time: the entrants can report their score right away.
forceConfirm.unplanned: This match isn't scheduled yet: it starts now, with no time announced to the entrants.

empty.freeScore: Free score: a remaining match can shift a pool without limit, nothing is settled before the end of the round.
empty.underfilled: Fewer than two qualified entrants: the tournament will close without a final bracket.
empty.none: No matchup is settled yet: they all depend on the remaining matches.

nextRound.stageUncertain: The qualifying stage may end with this round: these matchups will only be played if it continues.
nextRound.byeRound: sits out this round (odd number of entrants)
nextRound.sidesHint: The matchup is certain; the remaining matches will decide who, ranked higher, takes the left side and hosts the game.
nextRound.footnoteRound: Certain whatever the score of the remaining matches, barring a referee decision (withdrawal, penalty, double forfeit). The round is only set up once the previous one is over.
nextRound.footnotePlayoffs: Certain whatever the score of the remaining matches, barring a referee decision (withdrawal, penalty, double forfeit). The next stage is only set up once the previous one is over.
nextRound.footnoteShort: Certain matchups, barring a referee decision.
